clips.title: The story
paras: Outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Senir Whitebeard watches Dun Morogh's growing threats. The Senate of Ironforge sent him to assess the Frostmane troll offensive and report their movements to the dwarven leadership.

Senir Whitebeard carries the Senate of Ironforge's authority into Kharanos. The city's halls are watching the growing unrest in Dun Morogh, and Senir links the scouts on its snowy frontier with the lawmakers behind Ironforge's stone gates.

Senir Whitebeard tracks the Frostmane trolls, whose aggression is growing. Displaced and desperate in the frozen crags, they are pressing close to dwarven settlements and roads. Senir gathers reports on their positions, especially around their stronghold, for Ironforge's military commanders. He gathers intelligence rather than charging into battle.
